name: Invincible Presents: Atom Eve
source: Become Atom Eve and take control of your own path as one of the most powerful superheroes in the Invincible universe! Unravel a mystery and balance the dangers and responsibilities of being a superhero with the relatable challenges of everyday life.
translation: 成为原子前夜，掌控自己的道路，成为无敌宇宙中最强大的超级英雄之一！解开谜团，平衡超级英雄的危险和责任与日常生活中的相关挑战。
